description: Ground-truth manifest of deliberately planted issues in this fixture directory. run-self-assessment.sh runs a real Epyon scan against this directory and diffs actual findings against these expectations to validate that each scanner layer is actually working (not just running).

layers.name: SBOM Generation
layers.notes: requirements.txt (pyyaml, requests) + package.json (lodash) must appear as SBOM components.

layers.name: Secret Detection
layers.notes: Randomly generated fake AWS/GitHub-formatted credentials, never valid. A well-known placeholder key is deliberately NOT used, since scanners explicitly allowlist it as a documented false positive.

layers.name: Code Quality
layers.notes: Requires a running SonarQube server; not deterministically plantable in a static fixture. Best-effort only — verify tool ran (exit code / output file present), not finding counts.

layers.name: Malware Detection
layers.notes: Standard EICAR test string. Generated by run-self-assessment.sh immediately before the scan and removed after, since real AV engines (including on scanning workstations/CI runners) quarantine/delete on-sight.

layers.name: Helm Chart Build
layers.notes: Fixture has no Helm chart; this layer is skip-only for the self-assessment target (validated separately by tests/shell/test-run-helm-*.bats).

layers.name: IaC Security
layers.notes: Open ingress SG, unencrypted S3 bucket, publicly-accessible RDS instance.

layers.name: Container Security
layers.notes: Root user, no non-root USER directive.

layers.name: Vulnerability Scanning
layers.notes: pyyaml==5.3.1 / requests==2.6.0 / lodash==4.17.4 all have long-published CVEs.

layers.name: Direct Dependency Scanning (pip-audit, ML-aware)
layers.notes: pyyaml==5.3.1 has a known published CVE detectable directly via pip-audit.

layers.name: EOL Detection
layers.notes: Base image python:3.11-slim ages out over time; EOL status is inherently time-dependent and not deterministically plantable. Best-effort only — verify the tool ran and produced an output file, not a specific finding count.

layers.name: Container Analysis
layers.notes: Largely redundant with Trivy/Grype for this fixture's purposes; best-effort tool-ran check only.

layers.name: API Discovery
layers.notes: No deterministic API surface planted in this fixture; best-effort tool-ran check only.

layers.name: STIG Compliance
layers.notes: AI-generated assessment; not deterministically diffable against a fixed expectation. Verify the tool ran and produced a stig-results file, not specific control outcomes.

layers.name: Comprehensive Model File Analysis
layers.notes: Reused from tests/fixtures/ml-models/malicious — known dangerous pickle opcode payload.

layers.name: Model Card Compliance
layers.notes: MODEL_CARD.md at the fixture root deliberately omits the 'training data' and 'intended use' sections the completeness check requires.

layers.name: Network Discovery
layers.notes: No deterministic network surface in a static fixture; best-effort tool-ran check only.

layers.name: Model Provenance & Threat Intelligence
layers.notes: _name_or_path 'bert-base-uncased-cracked' is a Levenshtein-distance typosquat of bert-base-uncased; content-independent, doesn't require blocklist edits.

layers.name: Inference Environment Security
layers.notes: Reused from tests/fixtures/inference-configs — root user + insecure compose settings (privileged, missing resource limits, etc.).

layers.name: ML Runtime Behavioral Analysis
layers.notes: Opt-in only (RUN_ML_RUNTIME=true), resource-intensive (30-60s/model); excluded from the default self-assessment run. Covered separately by tests/fixtures/ml-runtime/malicious-*.
